about: Construct signature -> issue, for ingesting a customer's anonymized blocker report (#5054, tests/tools/blocker_ingest.py). `category` is a blocker_report.CATEGORIES value; `prefix` is matched on whole words at the start of the signature once every KIND_xxxxxx hash is replaced by KIND_*. First match wins, longest prefix first. Every entry cites an issue that burned-estate evidence already carries; no census or blind-estate repo appears here.
